decisions.game_name: game = 'LithoKraft' (capital L and K; caps style LITHOKRAFT) to avoid 'craft' trademark fights; lithocraft_* superseded but kept. Engine stays 'LithoLattice'.
decisions.engine_name: engine = 'LithoLattice' (one word, both Ls capital; 'LithoLattice Engine', 'Powered by LithoLattice'); plain 'Lattice' is trademarked, so lattice_* files are superseded but kept. Game = 'LithoCraft' (caps style LITHOCRAFT).
decisions.rename: game = LITHOCRAFT (formerly VOXEL COMPUTE), engine = LATTICE (Oct 9 12:43 PM ET); not trademark-checked yet, so Voxel Compute assets are kept alongside
decisions.tone_block: speaker/synth; back input = pitch (s0 silent, s1-64 = semitones from C2); directional, aimed on placement; front = speaker grille
decisions.thresholdor: reference ports on BOTH sides: left = LOW (down chevron + floor bar), right = HIGH (up chevron + ceiling bar). One side powered = threshold (out when input >= ref); both = window comparator (out when low <= input <= high). Engine takes min/max, so swapped values still work; the marks are the recommended convention
decisions.keyboard: SIXBIT codes 0-63 pulse out the FRONT (s = code+1); control codes pulse out the RIGHT side (s = code): 1 Enter, 2 Backspace, 3-8 reserved (Up, Down, Left, Right, Tab, Escape), 9-64 reserved
decisions.memor: directional: back = input, front = output (top edge of memor_top); aimed on placement
decisions.wires: every wire colour has a 6/128 dark outline per side; floor red 32 / blue 48; silicon unchanged
decisions.batch3_names: batch 3 names chosen from existing conventions (Oct 10); see docs/batch3_spec.md 'Names Cortana must confirm'
